text: Track send-to-durable-ack latency separately from recipient delivery lag. Watch socket counts, database saturation, outbox age, queue age, reconnect rates, and missing sequence gaps. Load test realistic conversations, then include a giant room, slow clients, and a reconnect storm. Kill a gateway. Pause a relay. Fail a database replica. Verify the promises still hold, and measure the behavior when they cannot. Capacity is evidence, not a box on a diagram.
